{{Quote|Do you always carry a deactivator?''"<br />"''Just because I'm a pacifist doesn't mean I won't defend myself!''"<br />"''Now you sound like a Jedi.|Obi-Wan Kenobi and Duchess Satine Kryze fighting off [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]]|<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" />}}
A '''deactivator hold-out pistol''' was a type of [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]] which fired a blast of energy that deactivated any [[Droid/Legends|droid]] hit by its bolt.<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> Despite its small size, it could also be a deadly weapon.<ref name="The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

==History==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rush Clovis/Legends|Rush Clovis]] used this pistol to threaten [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]] and save [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala's]] life.<ref name="Senate Spy" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore's]] personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']], was [[Skirmish aboard the Coronet/Legends|attacked]] by [[Assassin probe/Legends|assassin probes]] and [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killers]]. Duchess [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] produced a small handheld deactivator from her sleeve and proceeded to fire at the small [[Probe killer/Legends|probe killers]], disabling several with each shot.<ref name="Voyage of Temptation" /> While on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Duchess Satine used her deactivator to disable a [[Police probe/Legends|police probe]], which was following her after she had been framed for [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec's]] murder.<ref name="Duchess of Mandalore">{{TCW|Duchess of Mandalore}}</ref>

[[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr's]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] and killer, [[Lolo Purs/Legends|Lolo Purs]], also used this weapon to take Padmé Amidala hostage when she was accused of Farr's murder by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] senator.<ref name="Senate Murders" />

The [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mantu/Legends|Mantu]] also used one of these weapons.<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>
